parsed.why: Among worst states for anti-trans adult legislation: birth-certificate markers effectively closed, state-run facility use restricted, no gender-identity hate-crime or discrimination coverage, plus hostile national passport/border regime.

Worst-policies tier: criminal misdemeanour bathroom provision where a minor is present, extended K-12 facility ban, care ban, X-marker rescission, no gender-identity hate-crime law, atop hostile national regime.
Low-risk group: no facility ban, gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime enhancement since 2013, provider-based marker change; still capped by severe national passport and entry exposure.

Worst group: first state to repeal existing gender-identity civil-rights protection, barred local protections, school birth-certificate restroom rule reaching visitors; no documented adult public-facility ban.

Second-highest risk tier: school/college birth-certificate facility law but no enforcement mechanism, no state gender-identity civil rights, localized protections; less severe than criminal-bathroom or adult-facility states.
